rules: boost +1 when the title or body names a subject code the student is taking or has not passed
boost +1 for thesis when the student is enrolled in a thesis or capstone subject (SEP490, SET490, *490 to *492)
boost +1 for exam-registration and coursera-guidance when the student has a Coursera subject in progress
boost +1 for mandatory-program when the cohort token matches the student's cohort
lower to P4 when the detail campus differs from the student's campus

dedupe: same normalized title within 30 days counts as one item; keep the newest and mark it reposted
